reason: The cited evidence shows that SRO exists in HEAs and can affect defect motion (E3) and thermal stability (E1), but none of the passages directly demonstrates that SRO suppresses surface premelting, hinders surface atomic mobility, or raises the melting temperature of nanoparticles. The link between SRO and melting behavior is an extrapolation not supported by the cited data.
premises: Chemical SRO increases local bonding strength in HEAs
Chemical SRO hinders atomic mobility at nanoparticle surfaces
Suppressing surface premelting raises the overall melting temperature
SRO can be controlled by thermal processing (quenching vs. annealing)
